node.title: Coefficient-scale quotient sieve for primitive shift pairs
node.statement: For a subset S of a cyclic multiplicative coset D=alpha H, the maximal divisor c|n for which S is a union of order-c subgroup orbits equals gcd(n,e,{j:lambda_j(L_S)!=0}); equivalently L_S(X)=L_bar(X^c). A disjoint depth-t shift pair with maximal common coefficient scale c>1 descends uniquely to degree e/c and depth ceil((t+1)/c)-1, with deg(A-B)=c deg(A_c-B_c), and the maximal quotient pair is coefficient-primitive. Conversely every coefficient-primitive quotient pair pulls back with maximal common scale c. Hence every quotient-borne pair has c|gcd(n,e,deg(A-B)); at dyadic length 2^41 an imprimitive nonconstant pair has even e and even difference degree.
